original.target_description: Matching-title author working paper contains multiple ACT/RDT access, targeting, and mechanism tests; supplied input does not identify the assigned test.

replication.target_description: Unassigned side; no replication source inspected.

notes: Identity: supplied canonical text begins with the NBER PDF provenance URL for working paper w17943, reproduces the matching title and Jessica Cohen, Pascaline Dupas, and Simone G. Schaner, and explicitly identifies NBER Working Paper No. 17943, March 2012, Revised August 2014. This is an author primary research working-paper version of the named study, not an independently verified copy of the cited 2015 AER version. The supplied text includes main results Tables 2–7 and supplementary appendices through Table A7; no PDF path was supplied, so no rendering was possible or attempted. The input has null study_o, description, and es_type_o and an empty locators_o; it does not identify an outcome, treatment contrast, model, or analysis sample. Multiple candidates remain, and no target was assigned by audit_id, row order, or numeric matching. Candidate analyses: Table 2 p.42, ACT subsidy effects across nine treatment-seeking/access outcomes, N=631 first illness episodes with malaria-like symptoms, excluding surprise/subsidized-RDT households, household-clustered SEs. Its Panel A Took ACT coefficient is 0.187***; Panel B jointly-zero and equality tests are distinct tests and cannot be attached to that coefficient. Table 3 p.43, actual and predicted ACT targeting, N=190/189/178 respectively; ACT Subsidy=88% actual-status coefficient 0.187**, but 0.038** is the joint 88%=80%=0 p-value, not its individual p-value. Table 4 p.43, dosage mechanisms, N=984 households in Panel A and N=132/58 patients in Panel B. Table 5 p.44, RDT subsidy effects, N=1993 first illness episodes; Table 6 p.45, administrative targeting models with N=1776/755/687 and column 4 descriptive N=573. Appendix A7 p.A-13 contains coefficients, unadjusted p-values, and FDR q-values, but the assigned target is still unidentified. These are candidates only, not extracted target values. No analytic N is selected, summed, or inferred from df; no effect conversion or p-value calculation was performed. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
